title: NORA
lead: Nederlandse Overheid Referentie Architectuur — the Dutch government's reference architecture for interoperable and coherent digital services.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: NORA (Nederlandse Overheid Referentie Architectuur) provides architecture principles, models and standards for the Dutch government. It aims to ensure that government IT systems are interoperable, reusable and citizen-centred. NORA is maintained by the Dutch Ministry of the Interior and is the foundation for all government architecture frameworks in the Netherlands.

sections.heading: ITOM Perspective
sections.body: NORA is a mandatory reference in Dutch public sector ITOM engagements. IT Operating Model designs for government clients must demonstrate alignment with NORA principles, particularly around interoperability, open standards and privacy by design.

items.desc: The foundational design rules for government IT systems.
Enabling government systems to exchange data and work together seamlessly.
Use of open, vendor-neutral standards to prevent lock-in.
Building privacy into systems from the ground up, aligned with GDPR.
Sector-specific architectures derived from NORA for municipalities, Rijksoverheid, etc.
